items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: later on I met John Coltrane and met my wife Aisha Tyner

ctx.x: Well let’s go back and let’s talk about the house that you lived in when you were coming up. Did you stay in the same house, did you stay in the same neighborhood? If you could identify where that neighborhood was in Philadelphia?
I was there quite a long time actually, and then later on I met John Coltrane and met my wife Aisha Tyner and life just sort of grew.
And in what part of town in Philadelphia was your-
